Definition: to be violent; by implication, to maltreat
BiblicalUsage: 1) to wrong, do violence to, treat violently, do wrongly; 1a) (Qal) to treat violently, do wrong; 1a1) of physical wrong; 1a2) of ethical wrong; 1a3) of physical and ethical wrong; 1b) (Niphal) to be treated violently
